search.query: 2021-03-04 AI 新闻：OpenAI 多模态神经元与 CLIP 可解释性，核对官方博客、Axios 同日报道和 Distill 原文

candidates.title: Multimodal neurons in artificial neural networks

evidence.claim: OpenAI 在 2021-03-04 发布 CLIP 多模态神经元分析，并同步公开 OpenAI Microscope 更新和 CLIP RN50x4/RN101 权重。
evidence.excerpt: OpenAI says some CLIP neurons respond to the same concept in literal, symbolic or conceptual forms; the post describes feature visualization and dataset examples, discusses typographic attacks and learned biases, and links the updated Microscope catalog and research weights.

evidence.claim: Axios 在同日把这项发布解释为观察视觉网络内部表示、寻找偏差与错误的新闻。
evidence.excerpt: Axios reports that OpenAI’s CLARITY work found multimodal neurons in CLIP and says interpretability can help researchers understand bias and deliberate disruption in computer vision systems.

candidates.reason: OpenAI 官方页面明确标注 2021-03-04 并记录发布内容；Axios 同日新闻解释其黑箱、偏差和错误边界，Distill 论文作为原始技术背景。

candidates.title: Seeing like an AI

evidence.claim: Axios 对同一 OpenAI 发布进行新闻解读。
evidence.excerpt: Axios frames the release as a way to inspect how neural networks see, while retaining the risks of bias, overgeneralization and typographic attacks.

candidates.reason: 与 OpenAI 官方博客报道的是同一 2021-03-04 发布事件，保留为新闻解读，不另起第二篇。

candidates.title: Multimodal Neurons in Artificial Neural Networks

evidence.claim: Distill 原论文提供图示、实验和方法细节，作为新闻事件的技术背景。
evidence.excerpt: The Distill publication supplies the detailed visualizations and experiments behind OpenAI’s March 4 announcement; it is retained as background rather than selected as a standalone paper event.

candidates.reason: 论文是 OpenAI 同日发布的技术背景，主事件已有官方博客和同日新闻报道，不以论文单独填充日历。
